reviews.x: I have baby fine long blonde hair that needs help defining my layers and needing texture so it doesnt go and stay flat straight. I washed my hair the night before and put it up in a bun and slept like that. In the morning it creates nice waves but with no help the waves are gone in about 1 hour. I let my hair down and I am putting this through the test. My hair is about 5 inches above my butt, its that long. After taking the cap off I was greeted by a smooth looking clay the color of a creamy pe
Really good hold without leaving your hands feeling greasy.

reviews.t: Perfect for short messy and spiky
reviews.x: Tacky but pretty easy to work through short and medium hair.  I have a spiky messy style and its perfect.  It's the only product u have found so far that is definitely a matte finish with no shine and easy to style.  Awesome stuff.  The fragrance is mild and dull.  It could have a better scent.  That's my only con with this but the smell definitely doesn't bother me, like I said its very mild and subtle.

reviews.t: I'm surprised something other than TIGI works.
reviews.x: Pros: 1- It's not greasy 2- It's matte finish 3- It holds well 4- It doesn't smell Cons-NON ----I always spray a small amount of spray over my head after styling (not much). I found the only spray that doesn't leave your hair "shiny" and "weighted down" is "Sebastian Sharper Plus Extra Hold Plus"! The only drawback to this is the smell but it dismisses after a few.  Those 2 together make a very good marriage.

reviews.t: Works for men's hair short to medium
reviews.x: Great product for men's styles. Wet to dry application. Hold isn't 100% which is good and bad. For short styles it has much better hold. For medium to long it's a soft hold which allows manipulation throughout the day but also works product out and leaves a very non cohesive look. Works for higher styles combined with hair spray. My hair out grew the product it's too long to control with this product.

I LOVE this product!!!  I have used another brand for several years now, and I have just switched.  this product is much easier and is not sticky and is much easier to apply.  my hair does not feel stiff, it's much softer than the other product I have been using and lasts all day with no problem.  I believe I have just dumped my other favorite and have switched to this line.  it feels cleaner and not too heavy on my hair.  I'm hooked and will definitely order this product again.

reviews.t: Best molding creme in the industry
reviews.x: Highly recommended. No shine, barely any scent and long stylish hold. I've been using this product for the past 2 years and no complaints.
Bought this for my boyfriend who is very choosy when it comes to hair products. He loves it. His hair looks great and the smell is very pleasing. Not too strong.
I love this stuff. I have typical Mexican hair that literally grows straight out of my scalp. I usually put on Bed Head Manipulator first for some shine and then the clay for the hold.
Great hold, doesn't look gross in your hair, couldn't be happier.
Love this product. Adds texture. Goes on the way it stays, stays all day

I really love this product. The smell is pleasant. Very neutral not masculine or feminine. I have above the shoulder length hair. My hair tends to get very frizzy and wild. This tames it without looking like I have anything in my hair. It rinses out easily too.
Love this product, great for thin hair.  It is not heavy keeps hair light and soft with great all day hold.  Use it on wet or dry hair for different looks.  I will always buy and use this product.

reviews.t: love it more than American Crew Fiber and all others
reviews.x: I've used the following:  American Crew Fiber TIGI Bedhead Matte Separation Wax Gatsby Moving Spiky Edge (Pink Container) Mr. Pompadour  It's lighter than Fiber so my hair doesn't go flat. It's softer and cheaper than Mr. Pompadour.  Easier to work with and style (comb or hand) than TIGI Bedhead.  Not greasy at all like Gatsby and also easy to wash off, also unlike Gatsby.  It's the best I've found!  I was really surprised by this one seeing that is nowhere to be reviewed except for paid reviewe

reviews.t: Great Matte Finish Look with a Strong Hold
reviews.x: This is a great hair clay similar to pomade texture. You use it in a similar fashion, only a small amount is needed, and it gives your hair a strong hold all-day. Dab a bit into the palm of your hand and work through hair using your fingers to shape and separate into pieces. I particularly like clay over pomade because of the matte finish look. reviews.t: TBH not so matte and not so strong - kinda greasy.  Not what I expected at all.
reviews.x: I have used quite a few different styling clay products and this one does not stack up.  It goes on greasy and although it is supposed to be a matte finish, it definitely makes the hair 'wetter' and darker.  My hair is light brown and this makes it darker looking, sorta dampens the look of the hair.  My hair is straight and this does not really do much to help me style it.  I'd describe it as low/medium hold and definitely not a strong hold styling clay.  The worst thing is that even after a few
Strange fragrance, leaves hair dry looking yet greasy.  Didn't like at all.

reviews.t: Good product; less scent then competitors
reviews.x: Works well and, unlike many of the products of this type, has minimal smell.  One of the most annoying aspects of similar products is the strong perfuming used which makes you smell like a teenager who just discovered cologne.  The products does have a slight smell; however, it's more pleasant than overpowering and would require someone sticking their nose in your hair in order to smell it.

reviews.t: Smells nice, but the hold is medium to light
reviews.x: Smells nice, but the hold is medium to light. If you have shorter hair this may work, otherwise you will have to use quite a bit of it to keep your hair up throughout the day.
Its so so... Smells okay. holds alright prob will try a different product when it runs out. I have fine soft hair.

reviews.t: Okay for short hair; not so much for medium...
reviews.x: So this is an okay product, probably best suited for extremely short hair. If you have medium to medium-long hair, this stuff gets clumpy in a hurry. I've shopped around tons of matte clays and landed on Aveda (I'd order from their site, FYI). Main reason is if you want a stronger hold, you generally have to use more product. This stuff holds my hair all day and then some. I walked in fairly heavy rain for about 30min and when I got inside and looked in the mirror I was shocked to see my hair was still in the same position as when I first styled it. I only used a fingertip amount as directed also! My only complaint is it is mighty thick and if your hair isn't damp enough it will clump up in one spot. Other than that, I am highly satisfied!

reviews.t: The best hair product I've used
reviews.x: The best hair product I've used!  Smells great and works with many hair types and has a nice matte hold. Unfortunately the company doesn't have a website I can find. I want to order more, please Amazon bring this back! I'd even do a subscription to this! I've already recommend this product to others but it's now unavailable.

claims.text: Provides strong, all-day hold that keeps styles in place.
Leaves a matte finish with no shine and doesn't feel greasy or sticky.
Has a mild, neutral, or barely noticeable scent that most find pleasant.
Works well for short to medium hair, adding texture and keeping hair light and soft.
Hold is softer on medium to long hair, which some note can leave a less cohesive look.
